description: This file declares an API for managing and querying XPU devices, including functions for obtaining device count, checking availability, seeding randomness, and synchronizing kernels.

methods.name: device_count
methods.description: Returns the number of XPU devices available.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Returns true if at least one XPU device is available.

methods.name: manual_seed
methods.description: Sets the seed for the current XPU device.

methods.name: manual_seed_all
methods.description: Sets the seed for all available XPU devices.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Waits for all kernels in all streams on a XPU device to complete.
